name: Lone Pine, Penang, a Tribute Portfolio Resort
short_description: A 90-room boutique beachfront resort on Batu Ferringhi beach, Penang. Founded 1948, reopened July 2023 after a full restoration as a Tribute Portfolio hotel blending Malayan colonial charm with modern comforts.
ai_summary: Lone Pine is a long-established boutique resort on Batu Ferringhi beach that traces its roots to 1948, when Australian physician Dr Albert McKern turned a beachfront bungalow into a 10-room family hotel. After a loving restoration it reopened on 1 July 2023 as Marriott Bonvoy's second Tribute Portfolio property in Malaysia, now offering 90 spacious sea-facing rooms, most with a private balcony, plunge tub and day bed. It holds roughly a 4.0/5 rating on TripAdvisor across more than 1,900 reviews (ranked around #44 of 194 in Batu Ferringhi). Independent reviewers consistently praise the intimate, tranquil grounds shaded by mature casuarina trees, a large pool that feels secluded, an enormous breakfast buffet mixing European and Penang dishes (freshly cooked eggs, char koay teow), and warm, attentive service. The setting is a genuine beachfront with easy access to Batu Ferringhi's hawker stalls, bars and restaurants. Watch-outs are consistent across recent reviews: room quality and housekeeping can be uneven, with some guests reporting tired, dusty rooms, dirty shower screens, thin towels and slow Wi-Fi, and some long-time visitors feeling the Marriott rebrand diluted the original character. Beach sand erosion has also been noted at times.

faqs.question: Is Lone Pine Penang directly on the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes. It sits directly on Batu Ferringhi beach on Penang's north coast, with grounds and a pool opening onto the sand and most rooms facing the sea.

faqs.question: How far is Lone Pine from Penang International Airport?
faqs.answer: The resort is roughly 30 km from Penang International Airport (PEN) in Bayan Lepas, about a 45-60 minute drive depending on traffic across the island.

faqs.question: What makes Lone Pine different from other Batu Ferringhi hotels?
faqs.answer: It is a small, boutique property dating to 1948 with an intimate, colonial-era feel. After a 2023 restoration it joined Marriott's Tribute Portfolio, offering just 90 spacious sea-facing rooms rather than a large high-rise resort.

reviews.title: Lone Pine Hotel: Review of a Boutique Hotel on the Beach
reviews.author: Kirsten Raccuia
reviews.summary: A Penang resident praises the serene, casuarina-shaded beachfront grounds, spacious uncrowded layout and impeccable service. Highlights well-priced local cuisine, but notes the restaurant building needed renovation versus the rooms.

reviews.title: Lone Pine Hotel - Where to Stay in Batu Ferringhi, Penang
reviews.author: Keri
reviews.summary: A twice-returning writer calls Lone Pine a characterful boutique hotel: peaceful mood, super deluxe rooms with sea-facing balconies, attentive service, a generous breakfast and a handy Batu Ferringhi location near dining.

reviews.title: Lone Pine Hotel Review - Batu Ferringi, Penang, & Exploring Penang
reviews.author: Keith
reviews.summary: Reviewer praises the beautiful pool in spacious private beachfront grounds, a comfortable twin room with balcony and ocean views, and a vast buffet breakfast. Rates the independent property above nearby chains. (Updated Jan 2025.)

reviews.title: Lone Pine Hotel Penang (Review)
reviews.author: Mynn Lee
reviews.summary: A Deluxe Room review notes the sea view (partly hidden by casuarina trees) and private balcony plunge bath. The author enjoyed the colonial atmosphere and beachside setting but felt common areas needed updating; overall relaxing.
